Release firmware: TOSSIM, micaz. "Available on" lists the firmware whose `.defs` declares the symbol.


### LEDs

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `emit LED0(ubyte)` | Set LED0 (red): ON, OFF or TOGGLE. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit LED1(ubyte)` | Set LED1 (green): ON, OFF or TOGGLE. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit LED2(ubyte)` | Set LED2 (yellow): ON, OFF or TOGGLE. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit LEDS(ubyte)` | Set the three LEDs at once: bit 0 is LED0, bit 1 LED1, bit 2 LED2. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `OFF = 0` | LED off, for LED0, LED1 and LED2. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ON = 1` | LED on, for LED0, LED1 and LED2. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `TOGGLE = 2` | Invert the LED, for LED0, LED1 and LED2. | TOSSIM, micaz |

**LEDS**

<!-- check: ok -->
```terra
emit LEDS(5);   // LED0 and LED2 on, LED1 off
```

### Sensors

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `emit REQ_PHOTO()` | Request a light reading; the value arrives in PHOTO. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit REQ_TEMP()` | Request a temperature reading; the value arrives in TEMP. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit REQ_VOLTS()` | Request a battery voltage reading; the value arrives in VOLTS. | TOSSIM, micaz |

| `await TEMP` → `ushort` | Temperature reading after REQ\_TEMP: raw 10-bit A/D value, not a physical unit. | TOSSIM, micaz |

| `getPhoto(var)` | Read the light into a variable: emit REQ\_PHOTO() and await PHOTO. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `getTemp(var)` | Read the temperature into a variable: emit REQ\_TEMP() and await TEMP. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `getVolts(var)` | Read the battery voltage into a variable: emit REQ\_VOLTS() and await VOLTS. | TOSSIM, micaz |

**REQ_TEMP**

### Custom (loopback) events

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `emit REQ_CUSTOM()` | Loopback event without a value: CUSTOM arrives (with 0). | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit REQ_CUSTOM_A(ubyte)` | Loopback event: CUSTOM\_A arrives with the same value. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await CUSTOM` → `ubyte` | Loopback event emitted by REQ\_CUSTOM; the value is always 0. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await CUSTOM_A` or `await CUSTOM_A(ubyte x)` → `ubyte` | Loopback event emitted by REQ\_CUSTOM\_A; the value is the one emitted. With `(x)`: only when x is the value emitted by REQ\_CUSTOM\_A. | TOSSIM, micaz |

**REQ_CUSTOM_A**: Useful to signal between trails of the same program. `await CUSTOM_A(x)` waits only for the value x.

<!-- check: ok -->
```terra
par/and do
    var ubyte v = await CUSTOM_A;
    emit LEDS(v);
with
    emit REQ_CUSTOM_A(3);
end
```

### Radio

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `packet radioMsg` | TerraNet radio message: type, source, target and 20 bytes of data. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit SEND(radioMsg)` | Send a radioMsg to msg.target (a node or BROADCAST), in radio range; SEND\_DONE arrives at the end. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit SEND_ACK(radioMsg)` | Send a radioMsg to msg.target asking for an acknowledgement; SEND\_DONE\_ACK arrives at the end. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await RECEIVE` or `await RECEIVE(ubyte x)` → `radioMsg` | A radioMsg arrived from another node. With `(x)`: only when x is the type of the message. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await SEND_DONE` or `await SEND_DONE(ubyte x)` → `ubyte` | The radio finished a SEND; the value is the status (SUCCESS or an error code). With `(x)`: only when x is the type of the message sent. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await SEND_DONE_ACK` or `await SEND_DONE_ACK(ubyte x)` → `ubyte` | The radio finished a SEND\_ACK; the value is TRUE if the target acknowledged. With `(x)`: only when x is the type of the message sent. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ubyte setRFPower(ubyte level)` | Radio power of the program's messages, from 0 to 7; returns SUCCESS. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `BROADCAST = 0xFFFF` | Destination address of a message to every node in range (0xFFFF). | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SEND_DATA_SIZE = 16` | Size in bytes of the data field of msgBS\_t and msgGR\_t (16). | TOSSIM, micaz |

**radioMsg**: A packet is abstract: derive a type from it with `pktype`, whose fields take the place of `data`, and declare variables of that type.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `ubyte` | message type, chosen by the program; RECEIVE(x), SEND\_DONE(x) and SEND\_DONE\_ACK(x) filter by it |
| `source` | `ushort` | sender, filled by the sending program (usually getNodeId()) |
| `target` | `ushort` | destination node, or BROADCAST |
| `data` | `payload[20]` | 20 bytes of payload, replaced by the fields of a pktype |

<!-- check: ok -->
```terra
pktype tempMsg from radioMsg with
    var ushort temp;
end
var tempMsg msg;
msg.type = 1;
msg.source = getNodeId();
msg.target = BROADCAST;
emit REQ_TEMP();
msg.temp = await TEMP;
emit SEND(msg);
```

**RECEIVE**: The VM keeps two receive buffers: a message that arrives while both are waiting for the program is discarded.

<!-- check: ok -->
```terra
pktype tempMsg from radioMsg with
    var ushort temp;
end
var tempMsg msg = await RECEIVE(1);   // only messages of type 1
emit LEDS(<ubyte>msg.source);
```

**SEND_DONE**: It does not confirm delivery: use SEND_ACK for that.

**setRFPower**: The default is the one of the firmware build (4). The level is valid for the messages of this program and only until a new program is loaded. Values above 7 are ignored. The simulator (TOSSIM) ignores the power.

### Message queue

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `await Q_READY` → `ubyte` | The message queue (qPut) went from empty to not empty; the value is its size. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ubyte qClear()` (pure) | Empty the message queue; returns SUCCESS. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ubyte qGet(radioMsg msg)` (nohold) | Take the oldest radioMsg from the message queue; SUCCESS, or FAIL if the queue is empty. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ubyte qPut(radioMsg msg)` (nohold) | Put a radioMsg in the message queue; SUCCESS, or FAIL if the queue is full. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ubyte qSize()` (pure) | Number of messages in the message queue. | TOSSIM, micaz |

### Digital ports and interrupts

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `emit CFG_INT_A(ubyte)` | Configure interrupt A: RISING, FALLING or DISABLE. Each interrupt arrives in INT\_A. | micaz |
| `emit CFG_INT_B(ubyte)` | Configure interrupt B: RISING, FALLING or DISABLE. Each interrupt arrives in INT\_B. | micaz |
| `emit CFG_PORT_A(ubyte)` | Configure digital port A as input (pIN) or output (pOUT). | micaz |
| `emit CFG_PORT_B(ubyte)` | Configure digital port B as input (pIN) or output (pOUT). | micaz |
| `emit REQ_PORT_A(ubyte)` | Read digital port A; the value arrives in PORT\_A. | micaz |
| `emit REQ_PORT_B(ubyte)` | Read digital port B; the value arrives in PORT\_B. | micaz |
| `emit SET_PORT_A(ubyte)` | Set the level of digital port A (bit 0 of the argument). Configure it as pOUT first. | micaz |
| `emit SET_PORT_B(ubyte)` | Set the level of digital port B (bit 0 of the argument). Configure it as pOUT first. | micaz |
| `await INT_A` → `ushort` | Interrupt A happened (configured with CFG\_INT\_A). | micaz |
| `await INT_B` → `ushort` | Interrupt B happened (configured with CFG\_INT\_B). | micaz |
| `await PORT_A` → `ushort` | Level of digital port A, after REQ\_PORT\_A. | micaz |
| `await PORT_B` → `ushort` | Level of digital port B, after REQ\_PORT\_B. | micaz |
| `DISABLE = 2` | Interrupt disabled, for CFG\_INT\_A and CFG\_INT\_B. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `FALLING = 0` | Interrupt on the falling edge, for CFG\_INT\_A and CFG\_INT\_B. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `pIN = 0` | Port configured as input, for CFG\_PORT\_A and CFG\_PORT\_B. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `pOUT = 1` | Port configured as output, for CFG\_PORT\_A and CFG\_PORT\_B. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `RISING = 1` | Interrupt on the rising edge, for CFG\_INT\_A and CFG\_INT\_B. | TOSSIM, micaz |

### Microphone and buzzer (MTS300 sensor board)

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `emit BEEP(ushort)` | Sound the buzzer for the given time in ms. Needs the MTS300 sensor board. | no release firmware (firmware built for the MTS300 sensor board (`SENSOR=MTS300CA` or `MTS300CB`)) |
| `emit REQ_MIC()` | Start sampling the microphone into the buffer given to setupMic; MIC arrives at the end. | no release firmware (firmware built for the MTS300 sensor board (`SENSOR=MTS300CA` or `MTS300CB`)) |
| `await MIC` → `ushort` | Microphone sampling finished: the buffer given to setupMic is full. | no release firmware (firmware built for the MTS300 sensor board (`SENSOR=MTS300CA` or `MTS300CB`)) |
| `ubyte setupMic(ushort* buffer, ushort count, ulong period_us, ubyte gain)` | Set the microphone sampling for REQ\_MIC: buffer, number of samples, period in us and gain. | no release firmware (firmware built for the MTS300 sensor board (`SENSOR=MTS300CA` or `MTS300CB`)) |

**REQ_MIC**: Without a previous setupMic, the VM signals ERROR with E_NOSETUP. Needs the MTS300 sensor board.

| `ubyte fftAlloc(ushort points, ushort inverse, ubyte* buffer, ushort* size)` (nohold) | Experimental FFT module: allocate the FFT memory. Not in any release firmware. | no release firmware (firmware built with `MOD=FFT`) |

| Field | Type | Description |

| `i` | `long` | imaginary part |

### Runtime errors

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `await ERROR` or `await ERROR(ubyte x)` → `ubyte` | A VM error happened; the value is the code (E\_DIVZERO, E\_IDXOVF, E\_TIMEOVF, ...). With `(x)`: only when x is the error code. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `E_DIVZERO = 10` | ERROR code: division or remainder by zero. The result is 0 and the program goes on. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `E_IDXOVF = 11` | ERROR code: array index out of bounds. The write is discarded; a read returns element 0. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `E_NOSETUP = 21` | ERROR code: REQ\_MIC emitted before setupMic. | no release firmware (firmware built for the MTS300 sensor board (`SENSOR=MTS300CA` or `MTS300CB`)) |
| `E_STKOVF = 20` | ERROR code: stack overflow. Fatal: the program stops. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `E_TIMEOVF = 12` | ERROR code: await time above the maximum (about 24.8 days); the wait is clamped to it. | TOSSIM, micaz |

**E_TIMEOVF**: A constant time above the maximum is a compile error (E6007). A variable or expression that goes above it waits the maximum and signals this error.

### General

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `ubyte getMem(ushort addr)` (pure) | One byte of the VM memory, at the given address. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ushort getNodeId()` (pure) | The id of this node. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ulong getTime()` (pure) | The VM clock, in the unit of await (1/1024 s). | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ushort random()` (pure) | A 16-bit random number. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await_until(ret, evt, cond)` | Wait for an event until a condition holds, keeping the last value in a variable. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `FALSE = 0` | Boolean false (0). | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SUCCESS = 0` | Status value: the operation succeeded (0). Any other status is a TinyOS error code. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `TRUE = 1` | Boolean true (1). | TOSSIM, micaz |

**getTime**: The unit is 1/1024 s, not decimal milliseconds: the difference of two getTime() values divided by 1000 comes out 2.4% larger than the seconds elapsed.

**await_until**

<!-- check: ok -->
```terra
var ubyte e;
await_until(e, ERROR, e == E_DIVZERO);   // the first division by zero
emit LED0(ON);
```

### Nondeterminism

Two trails that use these symbols in the same reaction give a nondeterminism warning (W2xxx): the order of the effects is not defined.

| Symbol | Conflicts with |
|---|---|
| `CFG_INT_A` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `CFG_INT_B` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `CFG_PORT_A` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `CFG_PORT_B` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `LED0` | `LEDS`, `LED0`, `LED1`, `LED2` |
| `LED1` | `LEDS`, `LED0`, `LED1`, `LED2` |
| `LED2` | `LEDS`, `LED0`, `LED1`, `LED2` |
| `LEDS` | `LEDS`, `LED0`, `LED1`, `LED2` |
| `REQ_CUSTOM_A` | `REQ_CUSTOM_A` |
| `REQ_PHOTO` | `REQ_TEMP`, `REQ_PHOTO`, `REQ_VOLTS` |
| `REQ_PORT_A` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `REQ_PORT_B` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `REQ_TEMP` | `REQ_TEMP`, `REQ_PHOTO`, `REQ_VOLTS` |
| `REQ_VOLTS` | `REQ_TEMP`, `REQ_PHOTO`, `REQ_VOLTS` |
| `SEND` | `SEND`, `SEND_ACK` |
| `SEND_ACK` | `SEND`, `SEND_ACK` |
| `SET_PORT_A` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `SET_PORT_B` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
